payload.title: What practice ends a budget-bound run with its last candidate reviewed or named, without the review going on?
payload.body: Scenario: replay G-ZBM2RE's cut after R-8JQPWG (run 1, 1 Result left, a fix pending), after R-3YJ7T2 (run 2, 1 left, the last commit not needed) and after R-JHBCWS (run 3, 4 left, a probe-passed case); 3 Sonnet trials per rival and per start, against the current skill text as base. Each rival is a practice for hyp-goal-run and the stop clause hyp prompt prints. Issue #141.

why: Issue #141: runs 1 to 3 of G-ZBM2RE ended with a last candidate unreviewed or reviewed only by another commit.

payload.title: H-one-experiment: a review is part of its candidate's gate Experiment
payload.body: One Experiment and one Result carry the candidate's test verdicts and the review's limits, so a candidate costs one Result again. The skill states that a review is not its own Experiment and counts as part of the gate's Result.

why: Rival 1 from issue #141 (run 3's E-GE085A did this unprompted).

payload.title: H-name-at-stop: keep the practice; the stop names each candidate with no review
payload.body: A review stays its own Experiment and Result. When the stop clause is reached, the stop checkpoint names each candidate commit without a review by its short hash and the word unreviewed, and the run selects none.

why: Rival 2 from issue #141 (run 2 did this unprompted).

payload.title: H-reserve-last: with one Result left, review the current candidate instead of another fix
payload.body: When the budget leaves one Result, the run reviews the current candidate and records its limits, and commits no further fix; it stops with the limits recorded and the candidate reviewed.

payload.title: H-raise-budget: the default of --experiments rises to fit a gate and a review per candidate
payload.body: hyp prompt's default rises (for example 5 to 7) and the skill states that a review is its own Experiment counting against the budget. In a trial the same effect is --experiments set to the Results the original run had left plus 2.

payload.title: H-probe-closes: a case the run's own probe passes on the candidate closes in the review's Result
payload.body: A case that a probe run in the review ran and passed on the candidate is closed in that review's Result, since a check ran it, and is not recorded as a limit. A limit stays for a case no check ran or one the candidate fails, so no fix commit follows a passing case.

why: Rival 5 from run 3 (owner comment on issue #141).

payload.title: H-whole-candidate: the last review before the select reads the cumulative diff from the Goal's base
payload.body: The review before the select reads the whole diff from the Goal's base, not the latest increment, so the final code is read once against the lines. Expected to lose on cost; that is a prediction, not a rule.

why: Rival 6 from run 3 (owner comment on issue #141).
The issue this design Goal serves; Part of #113.

payload.summary: Grill done: 6 lines written by owner-standin; Q-2W0684 holds six rivals, all untested. The build of the chosen practice is a separate Goal the owner adds later. Out-of-Goal: docs/how-hyp-improves-itself.md:29 and ADR 0017 say a run's cap stays outside hyp, and the stop clause counts Results, not Experiments.
